dataType.title: What to fetch
dataType.description: Broadcast schedule: one row per episode airing on TV networks. Streaming releases: one row per episode released on web and streaming services. Show lookup: one row per show matched from your searches.
enumTitles: Broadcast TV schedule (1 row per episode)

country.title: Country
country.description: 2 letter country code (US, GB, DE, AU...) for the schedule. Leave empty in Streaming mode to get worldwide releases. Ignored for Show lookup.

startDate.title: From date
startDate.description: First day to fetch, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for today. Ignored for Show lookup.

endDate.title: To date
endDate.description: Last day to fetch, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for a single day. Ranges are capped at 31 days per run. Ignored for Show lookup.

queries.title: Show searches
queries.description: For Show lookup mode: show names to search, one per line.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Matches per search
maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many best matches to return per show search.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total (protects your budget on date ranges).
